lines.zh: 绿足缓缓挪动，阳光下闪烁着微光。
lines.en: Greenfeet moves slowly, glowing under the sun.

lines.zh: 阳光中，绿足的身影若隐若现。
lines.en: Greenfeet's silhouette flickers in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 绿足在阳光下发出微弱光芒。
lines.en: Greenfeet glows faintly in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 阳光下，绿足似乎更危险了。
lines.en: In the sunlight, Greenfeet appears even more dangerous.
Greenfeet shuffles under the sun.

lines.zh: 阳光下，绿足似乎在寻找什么。
lines.en: Greenfeet looks around in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 阳光下，绿足显得更加脆弱。
lines.en: Greenfeet looks more vulnerable in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 阳光下，绿足开始加快步伐。
lines.en: Greenfeet speeds up in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 阳光下，绿足慢慢消失在视线中。
lines.en: Greenfeet fades into the sunlight.

lines.zh: 绿足在阳光下显得格外苍白。
lines.en: Greenfeet looks particularly pale in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 我踩着伊甸的草，脚步发烫。
lines.en: I tread Eden's grass with burning steps.

lines.zh: 绿足踏过花丛，影子晃动。
lines.en: My green feet cross the flowers, shadow swaying.

lines.zh: 绿足静静站立，阳光下纹丝不动。
lines.en: Greenfeet stands still, unchanging in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 阳光下，绿足似乎在等待。
lines.en: Greenfeet waits in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 绿足在阳光下保持原状。
lines.en: Greenfeet stays the same in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 阳光下，绿足显得更加静止。
lines.en: Greenfeet is still in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 绿足在阳光下保持沉默。
lines.en: Greenfeet remains silent in the sunlight.
Greenfeet nods slowly in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 阳光下，绿足似乎在思考。
lines.en: Greenfeet thinks in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 绿足在阳光下显得更加寂静。
lines.en: Greenfeet is quiet in the sunlight.
Greenfeet does not move in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 绿足在阳光下显得更加凝重。
lines.en: Greenfeet is more serious in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 绿足抬头，目光在阳光下显得幽邃。
lines.en: Greenfeet looks up, its gaze deep in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 绿足的目光在阳光下穿透一切。
lines.en: Greenfeet’s gaze penetrates in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 绿足注意到玩家，阳光下眼神锐利。
lines.en: Greenfeet notices the player, its gaze sharp in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 绿足在阳光下注视着玩家。
lines.en: Greenfeet watches the player in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 绿足的目光在阳光下显得更加锐利。
lines.en: Greenfeet’s gaze is sharper in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 绿足的目光在阳光下显得更加坚定。
lines.en: Greenfeet’s gaze is more determined in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 绿足在阳光下盯着玩家。
lines.en: Greenfeet stares at the player in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 绿足在阳光下盯着玩家，显得更加警觉。
lines.en: Greenfeet watches the player more alert in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 绿足在阳光下注意到了玩家。
lines.en: Greenfeet notices the player in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 绿足在阳光下紧紧盯着玩家。
lines.en: Greenfeet fixes its gaze on the player in the sunlight.
Greenfeet moans as it falls.
Greenfeet struggles to move.
Greenfeet wheezes.
Greenfeet gasps as it crawls.
Greenfeet hisses.
Greenfeet groans in pain.
Greenfeet shivers.
Greenfeet hisses heavily.
Greenfeet trembles weakly.
My skin is catching fire again.
You glow like a fireball in the sun!

lines.zh: 别靠近，我随时可能自燃！
lines.en: Stay back, I may ignite at any time!

lines.zh: 找块阴凉地方，不然我会燃烧！
lines.en: Find a shady spot, or I'll combust!
You're my meal?
Come on, taste my flames!

lines.zh: 阳光让我无法控制自己！
lines.en: The sun makes me lose control!
Elemental fire gathers in my body!
I'm safer in the dark!
I need more darkness!
You remind me of the sun!
Be careful, I might explode!
Get out of the way, or you'll get roasted!
We collided! Move away!

lines.zh: 我的皮肤在摩擦下燃烧！
lines.en: My skin burns from the friction!
Collisions ignite my flames!
You hit my flames!
You almost set me on fire with the collision!
Be careful touching me, I'll burn!

lines.zh: 我的火焰被你触碰到了！
lines.en: My flames were touched by you!
Don't touch me, I ignite easily!

lines.zh: 我是唯一能生孩子的绿足！
lines.en: I'm the only Greenfeet that can reproduce!
I can reproduce only with a partner!
True love is only between Greenfeet!
Find my kind, mate!

lines.zh: 晒不死的同伴，才配靠近。
lines.en: Only one who survives the sun may come near me.
Mate with me to survive!

lines.zh: 找到我的伴侣，才能繁衍！
lines.en: Find my mate to reproduce!

lines.zh: 我需要一个绿足来繁衍！
lines.en: I need a Greenfeet to reproduce!

lines.zh: 只有同类才能使我的生命延续！
lines.en: Only my kind can extend my life!

lines.zh: 找我交配，才能生存下去！
lines.en: Mate with me to survive!
Greenfeet coming!
Eden Soul!
My sunlight!
I'm Greenfeet!
Get away!
Don't bother me!
Flame of fury!
Sunburn you!
Stay away!
I won't die!

lines.zh: 我脚下这片草是伊甸的。
lines.en: This grass under me is Eden's.
Move in the sun!

lines.zh: 伊甸的阳光下我也敢追。
lines.en: Even in Eden's sun, I give chase.

lines.zh: 我焦黑的手指已经对准你。
lines.en: My charred fingers are already aimed at you.

lines.zh: 伊甸的阳光先点着我的皮。
lines.en: Eden's sunlight lights my skin before I reach you.
Prey in the sun!
Sunlight hunting!
The moment the green smoke rises, I walk at you.
Sunlight is burning my green feet.
My sun food!

lines.zh: 你身上的活气，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the life in you.

lines.zh: 伊甸的太阳晒得我发疼。
lines.en: Eden's sun burns me raw.

lines.zh: 走近点，我的手就够到你了。
lines.en: Come closer and my hand can reach you.
Eight points of force; one blow is enough.
I choose you there in the shade.
Focus in the sun!
Burn their souls!
Guidance of flames!
Anger in the sun!
I'm Greenfeet!
Power in the sun!
Destruction in flames!
Prey in the sun!
Guidance of flames!
Death in the sun!

lines.zh: 我扑过来，皮肉冒起青烟。
lines.en: I lunge, and my flesh smokes.
The sun burns me, so I burn you first.
My green feet scorch the grass.
Run for the shade; I follow.
I raise a hand, knuckles already dried by heat.
I am slow, but I do not stop.

lines.zh: 阳光刺眼，我眯着眼看你。
lines.en: The glare is harsh; I squint at you.

lines.zh: 你退到阴凉处，我就守在外头。
lines.en: Retreat into the cool and I wait outside.
Sssss, I'll burn you!

lines.zh: 绿足来了，准备好燃烧吧！
lines.en: Greenfeet coming, get ready to burn!
Green feet on the ground, and the sun burns me.
I'm stronger in the sun!
Flames consume all!
Burn, my fire song!
Greenfeet, the burning messenger!
Flame soul, my power!

lines.zh: 别靠近我，否则你会后悔！
lines.en: Stay back, or you'll regret it!
Greenfeet, the burning roar!

lines.zh: 我一拳砸下去，草都焦了。
lines.en: I bring my fist down and the grass chars.
My flesh splits and flames leap out.

lines.zh: 抓住你的肩膀，烫得你松手。
lines.en: I grip your shoulder until the heat makes you let go.
One shove and you are on the ground.

lines.zh: 白光照着我的拳头落下。
lines.en: White daylight falls with my fist.

lines.zh: 打中一下，我自己的皮也在烧。
lines.en: I land one hit, and my own skin is burning.
In darkness, I awaken!
In the sun, I'm reborn!
Eden souls guide me!
Greenfeet, the burning guardian!
Seek the light in darkness!
Eden souls, my home!
I am Greenfeet, the burning!
Darkness and fire, my wings!
Greenfeet, the burning symbol!
In the sun, I grow stronger!

lines.zh: 伊甸的花丛里，我站起来。
lines.en: I rise among Eden's flowers.

lines.zh: 我从阳光下的土里爬出。
lines.en: I crawl out of the sunlit soil.
A soul-flame flickers, and I open my eyes.
This garden is mine to keep.
Greenfeet's skin is on fire!
Greenfeet falls!
Greenfeet drowns.
Greenfeet is blown away.
Greenfeet is hit.
Greenfeet is hit by magic.
Greenfeet starves to death.
Greenfeet is struck by lightning.
Greenfeet falls into the void.
